camera_display.camera_appearance: Original cam_link visuals mesh; four Camera gizmos invisible

receivers.follow: Measured corresponding hor displacement along the robot horizontal axis in world XY
receivers.collection: At valid release above the receiver opening, move the apple into the cube center and hide in the same physics step
receivers.reset: Stop then Play restores all apples to their original positions and visibility
receivers.placement: Directly below the ext link origin in its release pose

tree_interaction.method: Terminal-approach geometric fruit/wood contact; root-pivot damped tree animation; PhysX dynamic falling apples
limitations: Contact is a geometric approximation at the final grasp pose, not measured force.
Tree sway is procedural animation, not deformable branch or stem-fracture mechanics.
Targeting error is deliberately injected for demonstration, not camera-estimated noise.

depth_registration.synchronization: Replicator Writer sync gate: RGB + optical-axis depth + CameraParams + reference_time

previous_single_frame_registration.synchronization: Replicator Writer sync gate; four render products, distance_to_image_plane + CameraParams + reference_time

depth_reconstruction.region_filter: two orchard bounding boxes in their initial local frame
depth_reconstruction.color_source: RGB from first observation of confirmed voxel

rgb_point_cloud.source: Replicator RGB annotator on the same four render products
rgb_point_cloud.synchronization: RGB, optical-axis depth, and CameraParams from one Writer batch
